Stratified Morse Theory for Euler Characteristic was introduced by Etiene et al. as part of a verification pipeline for isosurface extraction algorithms.
It extends classical Morse theory to handle the non-smooth nature of piecewise trilinear interpolants used in volume rendering.
The method was developed to address the limitations of smooth Morse theory, which cannot be directly applied to functions with discontinuities in derivatives at cell boundaries.
